I can’t run deployments or access your repos/systems. I also can’t fetch external docs right now, so I can’t provide live citations. I can, however give a safe, concise plan and exact commands you can run (or paste into your CI) to ship the release branch to prod and how to rollback if needed.

Immediate safe approach (recommended)
- Merge release into your prod branch and let your CI/CD do the deploy (safer than forcing a push).
Commands (run from a local clone or CI agent):
1) Update local refs
  git fetch origin
2) Merge release into prod (non-fast-forward)
  git checkout prod
  git pull origin prod
  git merge --no-ff origin/release -m "Merge release into prod"
  git push origin prod
- Wait for CI/CD to complete and pass the prod pipeline before proceeding with smoke checks.

Quick push-to-prod (only if you understand risks)
  git fetch origin
  git push origin origin/release:prod
Warning: this directly updates prod branch and may bypass PR reviews or required checks.

Pre-deploy checklist (must do before merge/push)
- Confirm all tests pass locally/CI (unit, integration).
- Confirm staging smoke tests passed for this exact release.
- DB: backup and confirm migration plan + reversible migration or downtime window.
- Feature flags: disable unfinished features or enable in controlled mode.
- Notify stakeholders and on-call.
- Prepare monitoring/dashboards and alerts (SLOs, error rates, latency).
- Prepare rollback/runbook and contact info for on-call engineers.

Smoke checks to run immediately after deploy
- Health endpoint: curl https://prod.example.com/health
- Run critical user flows (login, purchase, key API endpoints).
- Check logs for new error spikes and monitor error tracking (e.g., Sentry), metrics (Datadog/Prometheus), and alerting channels.

Rollback options
- Revert the merge commit (preferred for Git-based rollback)
  git checkout prod
  git pull origin prod
  git revert -m 1 <merge-commit-sha>
  git push origin prod
- If using kubernetes, you can roll back deployment:
  kubectl rollout undo deployment/<deployment-name> -n <namespace>
- If you deploy by image tags, redeploy previous image tag.

If you want, tell me:
- Which git host (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket), CI/CD system (GitHub Actions/Jenkins/Argo/Spinnaker), and runtime (Kubernetes, ECS, VMs), and I’ll produce exact commands, a PR description, and a minimal runbook you can paste into a ticket.
